games.headline: Siakam and Nesmith power the Pacers to a 106-104 win over the Knicks
games.desc: — Pascal Siakam scored 19 points and Aaron Nesmith added 18 to lead the Indiana Pacers to a 106-104 win over the New York Knicks in an NBA Cup game on Friday night.

games.headline: Wagner falls a rebound shy of a triple-double in the Magic's 107-99 win over the Bucks
games.desc: — Franz Wagner fell a rebound shy of his first career triple-double, scoring 35 points and adding 12 assists to lead the Orlando Magic to their first home victory, 107-99 over the Milwaukee Bucks on Friday night in NBA Cup play.

games.headline: Adebayo, Antetokounmpo make Heat history, Miami tops Cleveland 133-121 in NBA Cup game
games.desc: — Bam Adebayo finished with 37 points and 14 rebounds, Giannis Antetokiunmpo also scored 37 and the Miami Heat took control of East Group B by beating the Cleveland Cavaliers 133-121 in an NBA Cup game Friday night.

games.headline: Powell scores 33 as the Bulls snap 8-game skid, beating the Hawks 125-117 in OT
games.desc: — Norman Powell scored nine of his 33 points in overtime and the Chicago Bulls snapped an eight-game skid with a 125-117 victory over the Atlanta Hawks in an NBA Cup game Friday night.

games.headline: Grizzlies have record-tying 10 double-figure scorers in 142-111 romp over Pelicans in NBA Cup play
games.desc: — Jerami Grant scored 22 points, including seven points on an extended possession in the first half, and the Memphis Grizzlies routed the New Orleans Pelicans 142-111 in NBA Cup group play Friday night.

games.headline: Alperin Sengun scores 43 points to power Rockets past skidding Jazz 125-118
games.desc: — Alperin Sengun scored 43 points and pulled down 12 rebounds as the Houston Rockets held off Utah 125-118 in NBA Cup play Friday night, handing the Jazz their 11th consecutive loss.

games.headline: Castle scores season-high 32 points as Spurs stop the Warriors 123-85 for 11th straight win
games.desc: — Stephon Castle scored a season-high 32 points, Victor Wembanyama had 12 points and 12 rebounds and the San Antonio Spurs won their 11th straight game, rolling past the Golden State Warriors 123-85 Friday night to remain unbeaten in NBA Cup play.

games.headline: Trail Blazers beat Kings 120-107 in NBA Cup play for third straight win
games.desc: — Deni Avdija scored 34 points and the Portland Trail Blazers beat the Sacramento Kings 120-107 on Friday night in NBA Cup play to open a six-game trip with their third straight victory.

games.headline: Clippers overcome 40 points from SGA and use late run to slip past Thunder 113-112
games.desc: — Brook Lopez scored 26 points and Darius Garland added 24 as the Los Angeles Clippers finished off a 113-112 victory Friday night in an NBA Cup game, sending the short-handed Oklahoma City Thunder to a season-high third straight loss.
